research.sectionTitle: Infrastructure for the open AI commons
research.sectionDescription: Every resource MEYNG builds for Sango is published free under open licenses — for researchers, NGOs, and governments worldwide.

model.title: Open Sango Translation Model
model.description: Fine-tuned on a quality-filtered French-Sango corpus. Version v2-2 beats the NLLB-200 baseline out-of-distribution on FLORES+ and SIB-200 for Sango→French; for French→Sango the baseline is still stronger, and we publish that result too. Free for non-commercial use (CC-BY-NC 4.0).

dataset.title: Sango Vocabulary Dataset
dataset.description: Hundreds of Sango entries with French and English translations, pronunciation guides, and grammar context. Every entry carries its source and review status — unverifiable entries are withdrawn, and the audit trail is public.

npm.title: Sango NLP Toolkit
npm.description: Open-source tokenizer, language detector, and stemmer for Sango. Published on npm. Diacritic-aware by design — handles the 8 tonal diacritics of the Sango orthography.

values.sectionDescription: Free translation now exists for many African languages. What organizations still can't get is language AI they can verify — that is the layer we build.

firstMover.title: Beyond Translation
firstMover.description: General-purpose translators handle words. SangoAI handles the language — specialized grammar rules, domain accuracy, verified vocabulary, native speaker audio, and a full learning platform. Where surface translation ends, SangoAI infrastructure begins.

production.title: Checkable, Not Claimed
production.description: Message the WhatsApp bot right now. Download the datasets. Read the evaluations — including the unfavourable ones. We would rather be verified than impressive.

scalable.title: Built to Scale
scalable.description: The same architecture that powers Sango scales to any language. Swahili, Lingala, Wolof — each new language is infrastructure, not a rebuild. 2,000+ languages await.

about.sectionTitle: The AI Infrastructure Company for African Languages
about.sectionDescription: We build the translation APIs, NLP tools, and language models that enable organizations to operate in African languages at scale.
about.missionDescription: To build verified AI infrastructure for every African language — starting with the most underserved. We believe the next billion internet users will speak languages that AI doesn't understand yet. MEYNG is building the bridge.
about.visionDescription: A future where every African language has dependable, verified NLP tools — translation APIs, speech recognition, and language models — accessible to any developer, organization, or government that needs them.
about.whyDescription: Africa has 2,000+ languages spoken by 1.4 billion people, and only a small fraction have basic NLP tools. Free translation coverage has grown — Google added Sango in 2026, and that is genuinely good news. But coverage is not the same as usability: organizations working in these languages still cannot verify what machines generate. That verification layer is where MEYNG operates.
whyPoints: Open Sango dataset — every entry carries provenance
Native-speaker verification — the layer free translation lacks

technical.title: Technical Moat
technical.description: Community-verified vocabulary database, published vocabulary-augmented prompting methodology, and an open verification pipeline. The moat is data quality and cultural authority — not just compute.

cultural.title: Cultural Authority
cultural.description: Founded by a Central African native speaker with deep linguistic expertise. Our data quality comes from cultural understanding, not just computation.

firstMover.title: Judge, Not Just Player
firstMover.description: We publish our data with per-entry provenance and our evaluations with the failures included — building the verification standard any Sango AI, ours included, gets measured against.

partnerships.title: Strategic Positioning
partnerships.description: Built on world-class foundation models, published openly for AI community visibility, deployed on the world's largest messaging platform for maximum reach across Africa.

founder.name: Michel WENEZOUI
founder.bio: Software engineer and AI entrepreneur. Native Sango speaker from the Central African Republic. Built SangoAI from zero to a live platform — published NLP toolkit, open verified datasets, and vocabulary-augmented prompting research. Invited by BPI France to Africa Forward Summit, Nairobi 2026. Based in Paris.
